technical_comparison: VZ 10.4..11.6 V at 5 mA; ZZT<=20 ohm, ZK<=150 ohm at 1 mA; IR<=0.1 uA at 8 V; TC 5.4..9.0 mV/C.

Pinned native footprint has pads 0.900 x 0.950 mm centered at +/-1.575 mm (outer extent 4.050 mm). JSCJ Rev.2.1 suggests 0.8 x 1.0 mm pads, 3.24 mm center spacing, general tolerance +/-0.05 mm (outer extent 4.04 mm). Existing pad side clearance to maximum 0.65 mm terminal width is 0.15 mm each; terminal span 3.55..3.85 mm fits. Electrical pin 1 cathode / pin 2 anode is preserved. This is a dimensional review, not fabricated-joint qualification.
JSCJ Rev.2.1 500 mW/250 C/W is specified with its stated mounting conditions; both devices cover -55..150 C.

Thermal source and current-circuit paper screen completed: Diodes 370 mW/338 C/W at its FR-4 condition versus JSCJ 500 mW/250 C/W at its 1 in2/2 oz FR-4 condition, both Tj max150 C. The changed lower limit -65 to -55 C still covers all existing analyzed operating points, whose minimum is -40 C; no -65 C project use/storage requirement was found.
qualification_limits: The per-ref DC power screen is complete. Actual native-PCB effective theta and a formal product ambient rating are not established by this read-only review. Use the numerical theta/ambient ceilings in thermal_and_temperature_screen; do not transplant the 250 C/W test-board number into a verified-PCB claim.
Low-current knee behavior outside the tabulated test points remains unbounded in both data sheets; do not claim the nominal voltage at arbitrary current.
Native component/owner/footprint identity and exact cathode orientation need controlled implementation and regenerated evidence.
